headline: New draft agent guide for same-major Next.js version updates
summary: Adds a draft checklist document that next-upgrade copies into the run directory and hands to the AI agent for same-major updates. It tells the agent to install the exact version, skip codemods, verify, and return to shared.md for delivery. It is prompt text for a draft, experimental flow, so a short read of the wording is enough.
reason: Draft markdown instructions for an experimental agent flow; no executable code, but the text steers agent behavior so a quick read is warranted.
